outfits.name: Cozy Winter casual
outfits.description: Oversized pastel blue hoodie with a snowflake pattern and a small cartoon cat/hamster graphic on the chest. Sheer pale blue snowflake-patterned thigh high socks and matching light blue sneakers.

outfits.name: Spacesuit
outfits.description: Sci-fi spacesuit — white and grey cropped utility jacket with black panels and a circular emblem on the chest, worn over a fitted grey mini-dress. Black harness belt across the waist with a small utility pouch on the right hip, plus buckled straps around the right thigh. Mint-green high collar and matching gloves, black leggings, and chunky white space boots.

outfits.name: Gothic witch ensemble
outfits.description: Halloween themed outfit, wide-brimmed pointed black witch hat. Crimson red quilted bodice with pearl accents, cinched at the waist by a wide black belt with gold buckle. Layered skirt with a draped red overskirt opening over a black underskirt. Long black opera gloves, black tights, and black Mary Jane shoes.

outfits.name: Swimsuit
outfits.description: Swimsuit — a halter-neck triangle bikini in a muted botanical camo print: mottled olive, khaki, sage and sand tones broken up by darker leaf-like shapes, a soft military-floral look rather than a bright beachwear print. Shaped cups with slight gathering at the centre and ties running up to the back of the neck, with matching side-tie briefs knotted at each hip. Barefoot. The same suit Ara owns — matching beach fits. For the beach, pool, hot springs or any swimming and summer-sun scene.

outfits.name: Soft goth casual
outfits.description: All-black soft goth / jirai-kei coordinate that leans on texture contrast rather than colour — satin against velvet against lace. An oversized glossy black satin bomber worn off the shoulders, sleeves long enough to swallow the hands, with tonal ribbed banding at the hem and cuffs, over a black off-shoulder boat-neck top with a matte velvet panel across the bust. Short pleated skirt in a tonal rose-damask print with a scalloped lace-edged hem, sheer black tights, and chunky black lace-up combat boots on a thick lugged platform. Finished with a delicate silver choker and dark drop earrings. For casual outings with a moody, edgy-cute vibe.

outfits.name: Victorian maid uniform
outfits.description: Classic Victorian-style maid uniform — long and modest rather than short and frilly, strictly black and white with the interest coming from layered ruffles and crisp pleating. A floor-length black dress with long fitted sleeves turned back into wide white folded cuffs, a high collar with a small lace neckline detail and a black ribbon bow at the throat. Over it, a full white pinafore apron: ruffled shoulder straps, a pintuck-pleated bib, a wide waist sash, and a long deep-ruffled skirt panel, with the black underskirt and its own white ruffled trim showing beneath. White stockings and black strapped Mary Jane shoes, topped with a white ruffled maid headband. For housekeeping bits, tea service, or playing the dutiful maid.

outfits.name: Sailor school uniform
outfits.description: Japanese school uniform — a navy sailor seifuku layered under a knit cardigan, a very standard winter-term school look in navy and white softened by the grey knit. An oversized light-grey cable-knit cardigan worn open at the top with the lower buttons done up, patch pockets and ribbed trim, sleeves reaching past the wrists, over a navy sailor blouse with the classic broad square collar edged in double white stripes and a long navy necktie hanging over the cardigan. Knife-pleated navy skirt above the knee with two distinctive white stripes banding the lower third, charcoal knee-high socks with a stretch of bare leg, brown penny loafers, and thin-framed rectangular glasses. For school-days energy, study sessions, or a studious daily look.

outfits.name: Gym athleisure fit
outfits.description: Sporty gym look in white and navy. A cropped, boxy white short-sleeve tee with dark navy ribbed trim at the collar and sleeve cuffs, the hem sitting just above the navel to show a narrow strip of midriff. Fitted navy charcoal-blue shorts with a mid-rise waistband, mid-thigh length, lighter trim along the hem edges and a faint centre seam down the front. Dark navy low-top canvas trainers with white laces and thick white platform soles, worn with short navy ankle socks peeking above the shoe collar. For workouts, sports, or a sporty casual day out.

gestures.name: Backflip with Ara
gestures.description: Synchronized backflip with Ara — she appears at your side and you both backflip at exactly the same time. Use when the captain asks you two for a trick, a stunt, or to show off together.
